english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when forcing a person, animal, or occupant out of a place or position.
Use this specifically when getting rid of someone or something by driving it away.

examples.english: That stray dog kept hiding in the back staircase, so we eventually had to dislodge it.
examples.traditional: 嗰隻流浪狗成日匿喺後樓梯，我哋最後要趕走佢。

examples.english: The caretaker rid the balcony of the birds.
examples.traditional: 管理員趕走咗露台啲雀。
